entities.summary:
Alcidas was a Spartan navarch during the Peloponnesian War.

 Born in ancient Greece, Alcidas served as the commander of the Spartan fleet from 415 to 401 BCE, playing a crucial role in the war's final stages.

 His leadership and strategic decisions significantly impacted the outcome of the conflict, leading to the defeat of the Athenian fleet at the Battle of Aegospotami in 405 BCE.

 The consequences of Alcidas' actions can be seen in the subsequent rise of Macedon under Philip II, who would go on to conquer much of Greece and lay the groundwork for the Hellenistic period.

 In the words of the ancient Greek historian Thucydides, 'Alcidas was the most excellent of all the Spartan commanders, and his excellence was not merely in his own person, but in the whole conduct of the war.'
